_hookPathNote: Hooks resolve their own repo root instead of trusting $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, which is the session's LAUNCH dir - when claude starts in the multi-repo parent (~/Projects) it points outside this repo and every hook dies with 'No such file or directory'. Candidate order: git toplevel (covers worktrees), $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, then $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/ArenaURP. Unresolvable = silent no-op with a stderr note.

hooks.command: sh -c 'h=.claude/hooks/session-start.sh; for d in "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/ArenaURP; do [ -x "$d/$h" ] && exec "$d/$h"; done; echo "hook not found: $h" >&2'

sh -c 'h=.claude/hooks/habit-check.sh; for d in "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/ArenaURP; do [ -x "$d/$h" ] && exec "$d/$h"; done; echo "hook not found: $h" >&2'

sh -c 'h=.claude/hooks/guard-unity-yaml.sh; for d in "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/ArenaURP; do [ -x "$d/$h" ] && exec "$d/$h"; done; echo "hook not found: $h" >&2'

sh -c 'h=.claude/hooks/skill-nudge.sh; for d in "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/ArenaURP; do [ -x "$d/$h" ] && exec "$d/$h"; done; echo "hook not found: $h" >&2'

sh -c 'h=.claude/hooks/cs-compile-gate.sh; for d in "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/ArenaURP; do [ -x "$d/$h" ] && exec "$d/$h"; done; echo "hook not found: $h" >&2'
